findingDetails.title: A fully-permissioned measured turn inherits operator credentials and can reach hosts the repo-remote guard does not cover
Containment is inferred from no git remote with no assertion that the checkout is a prepared arena

spec_code.notes: header threat model overclaims reach removal

noveltyJustification: Second iteration: 2 new findings, weighted 6 of 6, no refinements or repeats.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: Security review of a live-turn harness that starts mutating workflows with bypassed approvals.

targetSelection.selectionReason: These files own the child environment, permission flags, containment builder and restore boundary for a mutating measured turn.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A measured turn with approvals bypassed can use inherited operator credentials to reach hosts outside the repo.

searchActions.result: only GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN/GH_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN removed; SSH_AUTH_SOCK and other secrets inherited
claude bypassPermissions, opencode --auto, devin dangerous with no sandbox; codex/dsh workspace-write
no scrubbing anywhere in the folder

searchLedger.rationale: The header claims reach is taken away; the environment builder removes three token names only.

searchLedger.invariant: A live arm must only run where the arena builder established containment.

searchActions.result: only git remote emptiness is checked
arena refuses in-repo and existing destinations but emits no marker the runner reads

searchLedger.rationale: Guard is a proxy; no arena assertion exists, but the documented operator path satisfies the proxy.

searchLedger.invariant: A restored path must stay inside the checkout.

searchActions.result: paths come from git status, are repo-relative, and resolve under cwd; failures are reported not ignored

searchLedger.rationale: Git porcelain emits repository-relative paths only; a malformed name fails the restore rather than escaping it.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Source of paths is git status output and every failure is surfaced as leftover/failure.

searchLedger.invariant: A measurement run must not write outside its own artifact area.

searchActions.result: warmCheckout starts the checkout daemon; intended in the arena
cost bench isolates SPECKIT_IPC_SOCKET_DIR; live runner does not need to

searchLedger.rationale: The daemon warm-up is the measured environment itself; no artifact leaks a secret.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Writes are confined to the checkout the arm measures and no prompt or env value is persisted.

direction: path traversal through restored git status paths
